test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Prescription safety glasses provide the _____________ tailored protection for individuals with vision correction needs.
solution:
The correct answer is 'finest'.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The superlative form "finest" is used to denote the highest degree of quality among all potential options.
 
• In this context, "finest" appropriately describes the highest level of tailored protection provided by prescription safety glasses for individuals with vision correction needs.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are incorrect as they do not convey the intended superlative degree that "finest" does.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Prescription safety glasses provide the **finest**__ tailored protection for individuals with vision correction needs."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 1: "finer"** is incorrect because "finer" is a comparative form used when comparing two items, while the context here implies the highest degree, requiring the superlative form.
 
• **Option 2: "more finely"** is incorrect because "more finely" is an adverbial phrase that does not fit the grammatical structure or context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "fine"** is incorrect because "fine" is a positive degree adjective and does not convey the superlative degree needed in this context.
